operators.mixed_plus_pipe: 2026-08-27 live contrasts were left-associative without parentheses; do not assume conventional AND-before-OR precedence
operators.mixed_minus: With the documented single-word spelling (` -word`, no space after the minus), the bounded UI/API contrast `A | B -C` behaved as `(A | B) -C`; `A | (B -C)` differed.  Use explicit parentheses for intent and preserve the raw expression.
operators.minus_spacing: The focused contrast `A -C` excluded the known item, while the adjacent `A-C`/`...-C` form was accepted as literal/compound punctuation rather than the tested NOT operator.
operators.textual_words: AND/OR are not the documented portable spellings; retain + and | rather than rewriting symbols

general_query.wildcard: Only a trailing * prefix wildcard is documented.  In paired 2026-08-27 rendered/API known-item contrasts, `*satellite` did not match the unhyphenated Nanosatellite record, while `nanosatellit*` did; `nano*satellite` and `nanosat*ellite` also did not bridge that single unhyphenated term, although `nano*satellite` matched a known hyphenated Nano-Satellite title.  Leading/internal forms are accepted in these cases but their literal-punctuation/tokenization rule is not documented or portable; do not synthesize them.
general_query.phrase: Double quotes request an exact token phrase.

proximity.phrase: ~N after a phrase requests phrase slop in token positions.

proximity.counting: One intervening token was admitted at ~1 and two at ~2 in the live nanosatellite/system contrast.

general_query.variants: No automatic plural, stem, or synonym expansion is assumed.  The live singular/plural and known-item contrasts differed; use explicit *, ~N, or | when intended.

typed_controls.title: A free-text structured title parameter, not the general q grammar: live quoted, +, and | title values did not reproduce q behavior.  It is not an exact-title assertion; preserve the literal value and do not add unvalidated title syntax.
typed_controls.autocomplete: Author, Organization, Type/stiTypeDetails, Center, Subject Category, Report Numbers, Funding Numbers, and Keywords are exact visible option labels.  They are not free-form q expressions; duplicate/missing labels fail closed.
typed_controls.subject_category: Subject Category is the separate 76-category NASA STI high-level classification; the current UI/API expose exact category strings, not the NASA Thesaurus hierarchy, IDs, USE mappings, or expansion.
typed_controls.keyword: The official data dictionary describes keywords as assigned index terms outside a subject thesaurus; visible case, plural, and punctuation variants are separate exact options.
typed_controls.nasa_thesaurus: The official NASA Thesaurus is a downloadable 2012 vocabulary with prefLabel/altLabel, USE/UF, broader/narrower/related, definitions, and scope notes.  The current NTRS UI/API do not expose a Thesaurus field or prove that Keyword uses those concepts.
typed_controls.type: The current Type control submits stiTypeDetails option labels.
typed_controls.source: Source is a result aggregation (current public label: STI Collection), not q syntax.
typed_controls.distribution: Distribution is a result aggregation (current public label: Public), not q syntax.
typed_controls.collection: PubSpace is a /collections/pubspace route scope, not q syntax.
typed_controls.language: No public language control or documented language search parameter is currently exposed.

dates.publication: UI Publication Date maps to inclusive published.gte/lte; official API documentation defines published as publication date for records available in official publications.
dates.acquired: UI Date Acquired maps to inclusive created.gte/lte; official API documentation defines created as the date the record was created in STRIVES.
dates.precision: The UI accepts calendar days only (YYYYMMDD; visible readback YYYY/MM/DD); no time-of-day control is exposed.
dates.timezone: The submitted bounds are date-only strings, so no client timezone conversion is applied.
dates.inclusivity: The 2026-08-27 live known-item contrasts included equal start/end dates and used both gte and lte.

semantic_unresolved: The public UI does not prove whether Subject Category selections expand NASA Thesaurus USE/related or hierarchical terms.

general_query.scope: The public search tips say the unqualified search covers all metadata fields and document full text; displayed matches identify title, abstract, author, and full-text fields in relevance order.

operators.mixed_plus_pipe: 2026-08-27 live contrasts were left-associative without parentheses; do not assume conventional AND-before-OR precedence
operators.mixed_minus: With the documented single-word spelling (` -word`, no space after the minus), the bounded UI/API contrast `A | B -C` behaved as `(A | B) -C`; `A | (B -C)` differed.  Use explicit parentheses for intent and preserve the raw expression.
operators.minus_spacing: The focused contrast `A -C` excluded the known item, while the adjacent `A-C`/`...-C` form was accepted as literal/compound punctuation rather than the tested NOT operator.
operators.textual_words: AND/OR are not the documented portable spellings; retain + and | rather than rewriting symbols

general_query.wildcard: Only a trailing * prefix wildcard is documented.  In paired 2026-08-27 rendered/API known-item contrasts, `*satellite` did not match the unhyphenated Nanosatellite record, while `nanosatellit*` did; `nano*satellite` and `nanosat*ellite` also did not bridge that single unhyphenated term, although `nano*satellite` matched a known hyphenated Nano-Satellite title.  Leading/internal forms are accepted in these cases but their literal-punctuation/tokenization rule is not documented or portable; do not synthesize them.
general_query.phrase: Double quotes request an exact token phrase.

proximity.word: ~N after a word requests edit-distance fuzziness; N is an integer.
proximity.phrase: ~N after a phrase requests phrase slop in token positions.
proximity.direction: The phrase remains ordered; a reversed adjacent pair required slop 2 in the 2026-08-27 live contrast.
proximity.counting: One intervening token was admitted at ~1 and two at ~2 in the live nanosatellite/system contrast.

general_query.variants: No automatic plural, stem, or synonym expansion is assumed.  The live singular/plural and known-item contrasts differed; use explicit *, ~N, or | when intended.

documented_public_api_diagnostic.observation: The documented public API diagnostic returned the same known-item membership for the focused wildcard and minus/OR contrasts as the rendered UI.  Counts/ranking are not part of this evidence; the browser adapter remains rendered-UI-only.

general_query.escaping: The official tips say to backslash-escape syntax characters.

typed_controls.title: A free-text structured title parameter, not the general q grammar: live quoted, +, and | title values did not reproduce q behavior.  It is not an exact-title assertion; preserve the literal value and do not add unvalidated title syntax.
typed_controls.autocomplete: Author, Organization, Type/stiTypeDetails, Center, Subject Category, Report Numbers, Funding Numbers, and Keywords are exact visible option labels.  They are not free-form q expressions; duplicate/missing labels fail closed.
typed_controls.subject_category: Subject Category is the separate 76-category NASA STI high-level classification; the current UI/API expose exact category strings, not the NASA Thesaurus hierarchy, IDs, USE mappings, or expansion.
typed_controls.keyword: The official data dictionary describes keywords as assigned index terms outside a subject thesaurus; visible case, plural, and punctuation variants are separate exact options.
typed_controls.nasa_thesaurus: The official NASA Thesaurus is a downloadable 2012 vocabulary with prefLabel/altLabel, USE/UF, broader/narrower/related, definitions, and scope notes.  The current NTRS UI/API do not expose a Thesaurus field or prove that Keyword uses those concepts.
typed_controls.type: The current Type control submits stiTypeDetails option labels.
typed_controls.source: Source is a result aggregation (current public label: STI Collection), not q syntax.
typed_controls.distribution: Distribution is a result aggregation (current public label: Public), not q syntax.
typed_controls.collection: PubSpace is a /collections/pubspace route scope, not q syntax.
typed_controls.language: No public language control or documented language search parameter is currently exposed.

dates.publication: UI Publication Date maps to inclusive published.gte/lte; official API documentation defines published as publication date for records available in official publications.
dates.acquired: UI Date Acquired maps to inclusive created.gte/lte; official API documentation defines created as the date the record was created in STRIVES.
dates.precision: The UI accepts calendar days only (YYYYMMDD; visible readback YYYY/MM/DD); no time-of-day control is exposed.
dates.timezone: The submitted bounds are date-only strings, so no client timezone conversion is applied.
dates.inclusivity: The 2026-08-27 live known-item contrasts included equal start/end dates and used both gte and lte.

semantic_unresolved: The public UI does not prove whether Subject Category selections expand NASA Thesaurus USE/related or hierarchical terms.

The current UI/API do not document a general literal-punctuation or tokenizer rule for leading/internal *; the bounded contrasts do not justify a universal analyzer claim. Only the documented trailing prefix wildcard is portable.

syntax.ui_keyword_filter: Select one exact visible Keyword option.  It is not a USE/UF expression and has no documented plural, case, synonym, or hierarchy expansion.

nasa_thesaurus.known_item_effects: Citation 20190000219 has current API keywords nanosatellite, BioSentinel, and Biological science. ui_api_equivalence.autocomplete: The UI's Subject Category and Keyword autocomplete is backed by the first-party /api/citations/autocomplete route and returns strings.
ui_api_equivalence.equivalent_known_effect: For exact stored strings, the rendered UI and public API produced the same known-item membership in the 2026-08-27 bounded contrasts.
ui_api_equivalence.not_equivalent_or_unproved: Neither interface exposes guide category codes or NASA Thesaurus IDs, hierarchy, scope notes, release version, expansion/focus/major-topic settings.  Full UI/API equivalence and any Thesaurus indexing link therefore remain unknown.
